purpose: Teach: むら/しづ/やめよ/資料館/遅かっ/カモ/ゴロ/栓

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ネイル、色むら、出ないように、塗ってくれた、嬉しい。
lines.en: Aoi, I'm so happy you painted my nails so carefully — no streaks at all.
lines.style: Warm, genuine appreciation. Soft onset. Eyes-down tenderness, noticing the care in small work. Not gushing — just truly glad.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。しづちゃんと、よく来てくれてるよね、最近。
lines.en: Yeah. You and Shizu-chan have been coming in a lot lately.
lines.style: Observant, genuinely pleased. Light, conversational. The tone of noticing someone shows up regularly and being glad of it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 夜更かし、もうやめようと思ってる、私。
lines.en: I'm trying to stop staying up so late now.
lines.style: Quiet resolve with a trace of self-doubt underneath. Measured pace. Not confessional — more thinking out loud to someone trusted.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昨日、資料館、彼と一緒に行ったって、聞いたよ。
lines.en: I heard you went to the museum with him yesterday.
lines.style: Gentle probe, genuinely curious rather than prying. Warm but careful. Testing the waters to see how much Mei wants to share.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん。電車、遅かったから、ぎりぎり間に合った。
lines.en: Yeah. The train was late, so we barely made it in time.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact with a thread of private relief. Not dwelling on it. The casualness of someone who got lucky and is moving past it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 池のカモさん、可愛いよね、公園の。
lines.en: The ducks in the park pond are so cute, aren't they?
lines.style: Warm, gentle deflection. Small smile in the voice. Not pushing — just softly changing the subject to something safe and pretty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 休日、家で、ゴロ寝ばっかり、しちゃう、私。
lines.en: I just end up lazing around at home on days off.
lines.style: Soft self-deprecation, rueful but not self-pitying. A slight laugh underneath — admitting something she knows about herself. Relaxed, honest.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ワインの栓、開けたから、ご褒美、ちょっと飲もう。
lines.en: I opened the wine — let's have a little bit as a reward.
lines.style: Warm closing gesture, inviting and tender. Gentle pace, a small smile of conspiracy. The ease of offering something good to someone you're comfortable with.
